articles.title: Nvidia 'not intending' to bring back ex-CEO Jensen Huang | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 英伟达“无意”让前首席执行官黄仁勋回归 | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Nvidia's quarterly sales doubled to top $100bn (£75bn) for the first time as the company insisted it is not reinstating ousted co-founder Jensen Huang.
 
In the company's first results since Huang's dramatic exit, interim chief executive Colette Kress said it was "business as usual" and told investors: "We've got this."
 
The company's quarterly sales doubled from a year earlier, reaching $115.8bn (£86.9bn), with shares in the company jumping by almost 4% in after-hours trading.

articles.readingTextZh:
英伟达的季度销售额翻了一番，首次突破1000亿美元（750亿英镑）大关，该公司坚持不让被罢免的联合创始人黄仁勋复职。

在黄仁勋戏剧性离职后的公司首份业绩报告中，临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯（Colette Kress）表示，公司“一切照常”，并对投资者说：“我们能搞定。”

articles.title: Concerns over US cybersecurity amid tech outages | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 美国技术中断引发对网络安全的担忧 | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
The head of US national intelligence says a string of tech outages sweeping the country over recent days is not a result of a cyber attack, but rather caused by flawed system upgrades.
 
Outages in recent days have affected flights, banks and other infrastructure.
 
Last week, a massive Microsoft outage impacted schools, healthcare systems, businesses, courts and governments around the world - including the US and Canada - while an upgrade to a decades-old telecoms network grounded all US flights.
 
On Monday, thousands of customers at major US banks, including JP Morgan Chase, Wells Fargo and Bank of America, reported trouble accessing services. 
 
Chase Bank - the largest banking institution in the US - said a "software bug" in its hardware systems may have affected other banks and that it was not a cyber security incident.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

Chase Bank - the largest banking institution in the US - said a "software bug" in its hardware systems may have affected other banks and that it was not a cyber security incident.

articles.readingTextZh:
美国国家情报局局长表示，近几天席卷全国的一系列技术中断并非网络攻击所致，而是由系统升级缺陷造成的。

近几天的停电影响了航班、银行和其他基础设施。

上周，微软遭遇大规模宕机，影响了全球（包括美国和加拿大）的学校、医疗保健系统、企业、法院和政府，而一个已有数十年历史的电信网络的升级则导致美国所有航班停飞。

周一，包括摩根大通、富国银行和美国银行在内的一些美国主要银行的数千名客户报告称无法正常使用服务。

美国最大的银行机构摩根大通银行表示，其硬件系统中的“软件漏洞”可能影响了其他银行，但这并非网络安全事件。

articles.title: Iran says US has attacked Qeshm Island | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 伊朗称美国袭击了格什姆岛 | BBC 新闻
articles.summary:
Tehran says the United States has attacked Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, a site it previously targeted before the midterm elections.

Bahrain intercepts another drone attack from Iran, this time targeting US military radar systems in the country.

Hundreds of protesters take to the streets in western Iran calling for action after a fatal bus crash.

Motoring groups say fuel prices in the UK aren't falling fast enough after the drop in oil prices over recent weeks.

And in Yemen, the Iran-backed Houthis make further advances along the Red Sea coast and push towards the government capital of Aden.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#Iran #US #BBCNews

articles.readingTextZh:
德黑兰表示，美国袭击了霍尔木兹海峡的盖什姆岛，该岛此前曾是美国在中期选举前瞄准的目标。

巴林再次拦截来自伊朗的无人机袭击，这次的目标是该国境内的美国军用雷达系统。

在伊朗西部，数百名抗议者走上街头，要求对一起致命的巴士车祸采取行动。

汽车团体表示，在最近几周油价下跌后，英国的燃油价格并未迅速下降。

而在也门，伊朗支持的胡塞武装沿红海沿岸进一步推进，并向政府所在地亚丁推进。

articles.title: The unlikely way Democrats swept the midterms | Fareed’s Take
articles.titleZh: 民主党以意想不到的方式大获全胜 | 法里德的观点
articles.summary:
One month before the Democratic Party’s midterm triumph, the Pew Research Center asked Americans their views of the two parties. Sixty-one percent viewed the Republicans unfavorably, and 58 percent had the same negative view of Democrats. So how, amid this growing alienation, did the Democrats pull off a landslide?

In his take, CNN’s Fareed Zakaria argues that Democrats won because they ran on being the anti-party party, tailoring their candidates and messaging to reach voters instead of a top-down national strategy.

Later, Emily Bazelon, a staff writer for the New York Times Magazine, talks to Fareed about how Democrats should investigate and potentially be a check on the Trump administration.

0:00 Americans view both major parties unfavorably
0:41 Democrats won by becoming the ‘anti-party party’
3:12 Fareed: Dems are best on economic populism, not cultural leftism
5:53 How should Democrats handle probes into Trump
8:58 What about presidential immunity?

Watch 24/7 live news with CNN Headlines: https://bit.ly/4eIvlTr

Stream more on CNN with an All Access subscription: https://cnn.it/4AZMu54

#News #politics #democrats

articles.readingText:
One month before the Democratic Party’s midterm triumph, the Pew Research Center asked Americans their views of the two parties.

Sixty-one percent viewed the Republicans unfavorably, and 58 percent had the same negative view of Democrats.

So how, amid this growing alienation, did the Democrats pull off a landslide?

In his take, CNN’s Fareed Zakaria argues that Democrats won because they ran on being the anti-party party, tailoring their candidates and messaging to reach voters instead of a top-down national strategy.

Later, Emily Bazelon, a staff writer for the New York Times Magazine, talks to Fareed about how Democrats should investigate and potentially be a check on the Trump administration.
articles.readingTextZh:
在民主党中期选举大获全胜的一个月前，皮尤研究中心（Pew Research Center）曾征询美国人对这两个政党的看法。

61% 的人对共和党持不利看法，58% 的人对民主党持同样的负面看法。

那么，在这种日益疏离的情况下，民主党是如何大获全胜的呢？

CNN的法里德·扎卡利亚（Fareed Zakaria）认为，民主党之所以获胜，是因为他们以反政党党的身份参选，并根据选民情况量身定制候选人和宣传信息，而不是采取自上而下的全国性战略。

随后，纽约时报杂志的专栏作家艾米莉·巴泽隆（Emily Bazelon）与法里德讨论了民主党应如何开展调查，以及如何对特朗普政府形成制衡。

articles.title: Rubio: “No Evidence" Tech Issues Are Related
articles.titleZh: 鲁比奥：“没有证据”表明技术问题存在关联
articles.summary:
Breaking news this hour, Secretary of State Marco Rubio held a press conference and said there is no evidence that hackers, criminals or foreign governments are behind the recent wave of major tech outages, or that the incidents are connected, but he acknowledged that the drumbeat of failures has been unsettling for Americans.



Plus, new reporting in The Washington Post that the FAA oversaw and signed off on the router upgrade that's believed to have taken down much of the system, grounding thousands of flights and millions of travelers. Anderson talks with the reporter. 








Air date: November 17, 2026 













Guests: 



Todd C. Frankel 



Sen. Mark Warner 



Brett McGurk 







 


Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices (https://podcastchoices.com/adchoices)

Breaking news this hour, Secretary of State Marco Rubio held a press conference and said there is no evidence that hackers, criminals or foreign governments are behind the recent wave of major tech outages, or that the incidents are connected, but he acknowledged that the drumbeat of failures has been unsettling for Americans.

Plus, new reporting in The Washington Post that the FAA oversaw and signed off on the router upgrade that's believed to have taken down much of the system, grounding thousands of flights and millions of travelers.

Anderson talks with the reporter.

Air date: November 17, 2026 

Guests: 

Todd C.

Frankel 

Sen.

Mark Warner 

Brett McGurk
articles.readingTextZh:
本时段突发新闻：国务卿马可·卢比奥召开新闻发布会，表示没有证据表明黑客、犯罪分子或外国政府是近期一波重大技术中断事件的幕后黑手，也没有证据表明这些事件之间存在关联，但他承认，接连不断的故障让美国人感到不安。

此外，《华盛顿邮报》的最新报道称，美国联邦航空局（FAA）监督并批准了路由器升级，据信这次升级导致大部分系统瘫痪，数千架航班停飞，数百万旅客滞留。

安德森与记者交谈。

Todd C.

Frankel 

参议员

马克·沃纳 

布雷特·麦格克
